Parent epic: bd-01KY1BVCQVAYT48NJEGR7M2CP6

Implement the signed cross-run Rayleigh statistic retained from fmrireg.cca as a scientifically distinct estimand from the completed nonnegative within-training canonical root. Freeze the exact cross-run numerator, denominator, sign/orientation, exchangeability, fold aggregation, and null interpretation before implementation. Reuse prepared temporal geometry, runwise sufficient statistics, CanonicalEffect/OperatorProgram concepts, Gale spectral primitives, and ordinary MVPA traversal; introduce no CCA-specific engine. Acceptance requires an independent fmrireg.cca/base-R fixture, analytic signed cases, run/order/scale/sign laws, held-out leakage sentinels, typed degeneracies, and JVM/Scala.js parity.
set.title: One-shot MVPA: signed cross-run Rayleigh estimand
